name: Microsoft Azure Cloud Storage
mapping: Microsoft Azure Cloud Storage Default Mappings
description: This plugin supports ingestion of Alerts (DLP, Malware, Policy, Compromised Credential, Malsite, Quarantine, Remediation, Security Assessment, Watchlist, UBA, CTEP, Device, Content), Events (Page, Application, Audit, Infrastructure, Network, Incident, Endpoint, Client Status) and WebTx. The data will be ingested as JSON Lines blobs, either gzip-compressed or uncompressed based on the Compression parameter, inside a container of the Microsoft Azure Storage Account. This plugin supports ingestion in JSON format only.

configuration.label: Azure Connection String
configuration.description: Connection String of the Microsoft Azure Storage Account, used to authenticate with the storage account. To get the connection string navigate to Microsoft Azure > Storage Account > Security + networking > Access keys > 'Connection string'. Eg: DefaultEndpointsProtocol=https;AccountName={STORAGE_ACCOUNT_NAME};AccountKey={STORAGE_ACCOUNT_KEY};EndpointSuffix=core.windows.net

configuration.label: Container Name
configuration.description: Name of the container in which the blobs will be stored. The container is created if it does not already exist. Container names must be 3 to 63 characters long, may only contain lowercase letters, numbers and dashes, must start and end with a letter or number, and may not contain consecutive dashes.

configuration.label: Object Prefix
configuration.description: Name of the top-level folder in the container under which the blobs of this plugin configuration are stored. Blobs are stored as <prefix>/<data_type>/feedname=<subtype>/year=<YYYY>/month=<M>/day=<D>/hour=<H>/<epoch>_<uuid> (UTC), followed by the .json.gz (Gzip) or .json (None) extension. The prefix can be at most 200 characters, may contain '/' for nested folders (a leading or trailing '/' is ignored, so '/netskope/' is the same as 'netskope'), and cannot have empty, '.' or '..' folder names, backslashes or control characters.

configuration.label: Compression
configuration.description: Whether the blobs are gzip-compressed before being stored in the container. Compressed blobs are named with the '.json.gz' extension and uncompressed blobs with the '.json' extension. Both contain one JSON log per line.
